items.title: Steve Angrum Interview, 1961-08-08
items.q: Yeah, Joe Oliver. King Oliver. Oh, was Oliver's band? Yeah. King Oliver was playing.

ctx.x: Who was your favorite clarinetist of all of the old time men that you heard when you were a boy? Who did you like best? I liked Johnny Dawson's best. You got to hear Johnny Dawson?

Yeah. That was my favorite one. He was. Johnny Dawson. I knew him in Chicago. He was wonderful then, I thought. Mm-hmm. Used to play here, man. I'd run. Got to hear that bamboo I'd love to hear that man play playing. I noticed you sound, sometimes, some of the things you do sound quite a bit like that. Yeah, I used to listen to him so much. I used to listen to the dots all the time. I'd love to hear that man play. What was it, can there anything special you can say about his playing, particularly your life? Now…
Yeah. Did you ever hear Big Eye Louie much? Louie Nelson? Yeah, I never heard him much. I never didn't worry about him too much.
